notes: Computational Digital Twin - derived from available clinical and genomic data; not imaging, vitals or a scan of the patient.

System highlighting means: a documented patient phenotype maps to the system, or a non-benign variant lies in a gene whose knowledge-graph disease has documented manifestations there. It does not indicate organ damage.
Variant positions are those reported in the uploaded VCF (GRCh38 chromosome lengths used for scale); gene loci are not drawn because no gene coordinates are stored.
